SELECT mor.* FROM teacher t JOIN course_detail_record cdr ON t.id = cdr.user_id AND cdr.user_category = 'TEACHER' JOIN course c ON cdr.course_id = c.course_id JOIN minio_object_record mor ON c.course_id = mor.course_id WHERE t.id = #{teacherId}
SELECT s.* FROM student s JOIN teacher t ON s.class_name = t.class_name WHERE t.id = #{teacherId}

SELECT s.id, s.username, s.password, s.name, s.gender, s.age, s.major, s.class_name, s.teacher_binding_code, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.course_name FROM student s JOIN course_detail_record cdr_student ON s.id = cdr_student.user_id AND cdr_student.user_category = 'STUDENT' JOIN course_detail_record cdr_teacher ON cdr_student.course_id = cdr_teacher.course_id AND cdr_teacher.user_category = 'TEACHER' JOIN course c ON cdr_student.course_id = c.course_id WHERE cdr_teacher.user_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT s.id, s.username, s.password, s.name, s.gender, s.age, s.major, s.class_name, s.teacher_binding_code, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.course_name FROM student s JOIN course_detail_record cdr_student ON s.id = cdr_student.user_id AND cdr_student.user_category = 'STUDENT' JOIN course_detail_record cdr_teacher ON cdr_student.course_id = cdr_teacher.course_id AND cdr_teacher.user_category = 'TEACHER' JOIN course c ON cdr_student.course_id = c.course_id WHERE cdr_teacher.user_id = #{teacherId} AND c.course_name = #{courseName}
